newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Few changes in grain, soy markets.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Few changes in grain, soy markets.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, wheat and soybean basis offers were little changed Thursday, except for a one-cent drop in some deferred soybean offers, dealers said.

Nearby corn and soybean values remained firm because of a large lineup of vessels waiting to load. One grain dealer said he expects the vessels to be loaded in about 30 days, which accounted for a basis premium for March arrival grain and soybeans versus deferred positions.
Also supporting nearby premiums was high water on the Illinois River, which prompted speed restrictions on tows and slowed movement to the Gulf, dealers said.
